LESSON: HYGIENE IN REARING ANIMALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTISES Strand Sub- Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learni
Topic 3.1: Hygiene in Rearing Animals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hygiene in Rearing Animals. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Hygiene in Rearing Animals
2. Practise Hygiene in Rearing Animals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hygiene in Rearing Animals

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Hygiene in Rearing Animals
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Hygiene in Rearing Animals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Hygiene in Rearing Animals at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Hygiene in Rearing Animals at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hygiene in Rearing Animals
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Hygiene in Rearing Animals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hygiene in Rearing Animals using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hygiene in Rearing Animals in the examples.
2. Explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hygiene in Rearing Animals using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hygiene in Rearing Animals important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Hygiene in Rearing Animals
2. Practise Hygiene in Rearing Animals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hygiene in Rearing Animals

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
